subject: tu:game/game/combat
value: `probe.py` and `fndiff.py --clean` report DIFFERENT values for what both call the function's `real` residual, on the SAME object, in the same tree. Measured on game/game/combat.c::get_cam_dist with its webfrank rule disabled and no source change between the two calls: probe.py printed `real 146` and fndiff.py --clean printed `170 real diff lines` back to back. Neither number is wrong -- they count different line sets (fndiff --clean's count includes rows probe.py's verdict excludes) -- but the two are routinely quoted interchangeably in records and work orders, and a batch harness that scores with one tool while its baseline was taken with the other will report a phantom regression or a phantom win. RULE: fix ONE tool per comparison series and say which one in the record. This lane's batteries are internally consistent (battery 1 and the per-function probes use probe.py; the exhaustive decl-order searches use fndiff --clean) and the two families are reported separately for exactly this reason.
